issues.problem: ctx 2 (captain leads everyone another way) could be filled equally well by 毫不犹豫 from the same set
issues.action: rewrote as a deadlocked meeting where the manager makes the call on the spot (拍板定了方案)

issues.problem: ctx 2 (别再…了，喜欢就买吧) and ctx 3 (领导要是…) describe a single wavering moment; 犹豫不决 fits equally
issues.action: rewrote both to stress indecision as a character trait (…的性格得改一改; 一个…的人，很难当好领导)

issues.problem: bad 1 'why' wrongly claimed 优柔 does not mean gentle (it does mean soft, yielding)
issues.action: rewrote the reason: the idiom criticises indecision and cannot praise a gentle manner

issues.problem: ctx 1 and ctx 3 were both about markets, so the six contexts were not all different situations
issues.action: replaced ctx 3 with a patient's rapidly changing condition, keeping the attributive …的 form

issues.problem: ctx 4 (problems appear right after a project starts) fits 接二连三 just as well
issues.action: rewrote as new kinds of problems still cropping up after three years, which is this idiom's sense of an endless supply

issues.idiom: 朝三暮四 / 脱胎换骨 / 每况愈下 / 屡见不鲜
issues.problem: stories checked against 庄子·齐物论 and 列子·黄帝, the Daoist term, 庄子·知北游 (每下愈况) and 史记·郦生陆贾列传 (数见不鲜)
issues.action: kept; details and sources match the traditional accounts
